summary: One student page of the TypeMedia 2020/21 graduation site (shared template): a cover image of 'Anguilla', a three-column text panel (links, project blurb, designer bio), then a column of full-width 16:9 images (eel illustrations, glyph scatters, themed word stacks, a text setting) and a 'Process' chapter of scans, proofs and a desk photo. Images fade in, and the page background flips between white and black as the text panels scroll in.

instances.look: Sticky slim bar: hamburger at the left (opens an overlay menu), ← ↑ → arrows to the previous student, the index and the next student, 'About TypeMedia' at the right (opens a sidebar); it turns black over the dark part of the page and is stamped across many crops
The name 'Anguilla' in the black display style, with a looping calligraphic swash 'A', filling a white image band edge to edge under the slim nav
instances.ux: The cover image fades in on load (grey to black over ~1.5s); 'Jump to process ↓' sits just below
instances.learn: A cover image of the name in the display cut, with the template doing everything else, makes a strong first screen for a student project

reconstruction.layout: Image 1411×400 at x=14, y=93 (14px side margins, 2rem bottom margin); name spans ~95% of the width, centred vertically
reconstruction.typography: 'Anguilla' as an image, ~330px cap height, display style with a swash initial; nav ~19px CoFo Sans

instances.look: Three text columns: 'Jump to process ↓' at the left, the bold title 'Anguilla' and a six-line description in the middle, and 'Gajana Aslanjan' with a short bio plus mail, website and Instagram links at the right; white on black in the captured state
instances.ux: The page background switches between white and black (body.color-white / color-black) as this panel scrolls into view; anchor link jumps to the Process panel
instances.learn: A three-column panel (anchor links, project blurb, designer bio) gives a student or small-foundry project page all its facts in one band

reconstruction.layout: Full-width panel ~300px tall on a 12-column grid with 14px gutters: anchor column ~250px at the left, description from x≈390 ~620px wide, bio column from x≈1090 ~330px wide
reconstruction.typography: Title ~19px CoFo Sans Bold; description ~19px CoFo Sans Regular, leading ~1.4; bio ~14px (smaller-font-size) with bold link values
reconstruction.behaviour: Body colour class toggles between white and black per panel's data-color on scroll (CSS transition)
reconstruction.content: Real project description (text-to-display family: regular text, bold, display; flat-nib research) and designer bio with contacts

instances.look: Flat vector illustrations of the font's namesake, an eel: a green eel with a sparkling eye coiled over grey, and later an abstract close-up of green eel curves on white
instances.learn: Illustrate the font's name (Anguilla = eel) between specimen panels to give a text face a mascot and a colour

reconstruction.layout: Image 1411×794 (16:9) with 14px side margins, ~19px gap between images
reconstruction.assets: Two flat vector illustrations (gajana-1.jpg, gajana-p-4 area)

instances.look: A run of 16:9 specimen images: rows of scattered, rotated glyphs ('ja deg3 zG!?*ň9', 'ahegy i'G.rAc', 'alsze PndGf') on grey-over-white bands, and a large text setting about eels mixing Regular, Bold and the swashy display italic ('Eels are elongated fish…')
